title: Betűk és hangok
intro: Match Hungarian letters to the sounds they make.

items.explain: s = sh, sz = s. Think: saláta = “shalata”.

items.prompt: Which letter sounds like English “ch” in church?
Which two spellings make the same sound?
items.explain: Both sound like English “y”: joghurt, lyuk.
sz is the English s sound.

items.prompt: Which is the only three-character consonant?
items.explain: dzs is the háromjegyű mássalhangzó: dzsem, dzsip.

items.prompt: How many letters does “csillag” have in the Hungarian alphabet?
items.explain: cs · i · l · l · a · g — cs counts as one letter, and the double l counts as two.

items.prompt: Sort the words by their first sound.
Match the letter to a word that has it.
Write the Hungarian word for “jam” (it uses the three-character letter).
